meta.source: 手作業で作成した文脈推測原稿

sentences: He was too much of a partisan to chair a neutral inquiry.
He had campaigned for one side for twenty years and still paid its membership.
clues: He had campaigned for one side for twenty years
items.reason: 二十年一方の側のために運動し、今も会費を払っていると述べられています

sentences: The outage affected every household on the eastern side of town.
Lights went out at nine, and refrigerators stayed off until the next morning.
clues: refrigerators stayed off until the next morning
items.reason: 九時に灯りが消え、翌朝まで冷蔵庫も止まっていたと述べられています

sentences: The stallion's progeny won three major races that season.
Two of his sons and one daughter took the biggest prizes that year.
clues: Two of his sons and one daughter
took the biggest prizes that year
items.reason: その年、息子二頭と娘一頭が最大の賞を得たと述べられています

sentences: Tenants sought redress through a tribunal rather than the courts.
They asked to have the rent increase cancelled and their deposits returned.
clues: They asked to have the rent increase cancelled
items.reason: 賃料の引き上げの取り消しと、敷金の返還を求めたと述べられています

sentences: Universal suffrage was not achieved here until after the war.
Women could not vote before 1946, and neither could men without property.
items.reason: 一九四六年まで女性は投票できず、財産のない男性も同様だったと述べられています

sentences: An elephant on the rampage destroyed two fences and a shed.
It ran through the compound for half an hour before keepers calmed it.
clues: It ran through the compound for half an hour
items.reason: 飼育係が落ち着かせるまで、半時間敷地内を走り回ったと述べられています

sentences: Visitors can still walk along the medieval rampart above the river.
The wall is four meters thick and once had a tower at each corner.
clues: The wall is four meters thick
once had a tower at each corner
items.reason: 厚さ四メートルの壁で、かつて各隅に塔があったと述べられています

sentences: The plan came to fruition eleven years after it was first drawn.
The building opened in May, and every room was used by September.
clues: every room was used by September
items.reason: 五月に建物が開き、九月にはどの部屋も使われていたと述べられています

sentences: The partnership ended in acrimony and a long legal dispute.
They stopped speaking in June and wrote insults through their lawyers for two years.
clues: wrote insults through their lawyers for two years
items.reason: 六月に口をきかなくなり、二年のあいだ弁護士を通じて罵り合ったと述べられています

sentences: The port lost its commercial hegemony in the eighteenth century.
Its share of the trade fell from two thirds to a tenth in fifty years.
clues: Its share of the trade fell from two thirds to a tenth
items.reason: 五十年で交易の取り分が三分の二から十分の一に落ちたと述べられています

sentences: A simple blunder in the schedule cost the tour two performances.
Two cities were booked for the same night, and neither concert could be held.
clues: Two cities were booked for the same night
items.reason: 同じ夜に二つの都市が押さえられ、どちらの公演もできなかったと述べられています

sentences: The stench of the tannery reached the village whenever the wind turned.
People closed their windows, and two families moved away because of it.
clues: two families moved away because of it
items.reason: 住民は窓を閉め、それが理由で二世帯が転居したと述べられています

sentences: Volunteers cleared the rubble from the school yard by hand.
Broken blocks and roof tiles filled two hundred wheelbarrows.
items.reason: 割れた塊や屋根瓦が、手押し車二百台分になったと述べられています

sentences: The design shows real ingenuity in the use of very cheap materials.
Old bottles form the windows, and the roof is held up by bicycle frames.
clues: the roof is held up by bicycle frames
items.reason: 古い瓶が窓になり、屋根は自転車の枠で支えられていると述べられています

sentences: A small union with surprising clout blocked the whole reorganization.
It had only ninety members and could stop every crane on the site.
clues: could stop every crane on the site
items.reason: 会員は九十人しかいないのに、現場のすべての起重機を止められたと述べられています

sentences: Two inspectors were dismissed for accepting a kickback from the contractor.
Each received an envelope after signing the certificate of completion.
clues: after signing the certificate of completion
items.reason: 完了の証明に署名した後、それぞれ封筒を受け取ったと述べられています

sentences: A shipping tycoon paid for the entire concert hall.
He owned forty vessels and gave the city nine hundred million yen.
clues: gave the city nine hundred million yen
items.reason: 船四十隻を持ち、市に九億円を寄せたと述べられています

sentences: He had not the slightest scruple about reading other people's mail.
He opened envelopes on the hall table and never mentioned it to anyone.
clues: He opened envelopes on the hall table
items.reason: 玄関の卓の封筒を開け、そのことを誰にも言わなかったと述べられています

sentences: The watch is a memento of her first year at sea.
She has kept it for forty years although it stopped working in 1987.
clues: She has kept it for forty years
items.reason: 一九八七年に止まったのに、四十年手元に置いていると述べられています

sentences: The protagonist of the novel never speaks in the first three chapters.
Everything is seen through her eyes, and the other characters talk about her constantly.
clues: Everything is seen through her eyes
the other characters talk about her constantly
items.reason: すべてが彼女の目を通して描かれ、他の人物も彼女の話ばかりしていると述べられています

sentences: The drug reduces inhibition, which is why driving is forbidden.
Patients act on impulses they would normally hold back.
items.reason: 普段なら抑える衝動のままに行動してしまうと述べられています

sentences: The marshes are a haven for birds that winter in the south.
Nine species rest there in October, and no hunting is allowed.
clues: Nine species rest there in October
items.reason: 十月に九種が羽を休め、狩猟も禁じられていると述べられています

sentences: A cautious bureaucrat delayed the permit for another eight months.
He asked for two more documents and forwarded the file to a third department.
clues: He asked for two more documents
forwarded the file to a third department
items.reason: 追加の書類を二点求め、書類一式を三つ目の部署へ回したと述べられています

sentences: The union demanded parity with workers at the northern plant.
They wanted the same hourly rate and the same holidays, to the day.
clues: They wanted the same hourly rate
the same holidays, to the day
items.reason: 同じ時間給と、日数まで同じ休日を求めたと述べられています

sentences: The otter is a shy denizen of these upland streams.
It lives along nine kilometers of the river and is seen perhaps twice a year.
clues: It lives along nine kilometers of the river
is seen perhaps twice a year
items.reason: 川沿いの九キロに暮らし、見られるのは年に二度ほどだと述べられています

sentences: A ruckus in the corridor brought two members of staff running.
Someone was shouting, and a metal bin had been knocked over.
clues: a metal bin had been knocked over
items.reason: 誰かが叫んでおり、金属の屑籠が倒されていたと述べられています

sentences: The market found a new equilibrium after the tariffs were removed.
Prices moved for three weeks and then stayed within one percent for a year.
clues: stayed within one percent for a year
items.reason: 三週間動いた価格が、その後一年は一パーセント以内に収まったと述べられています

sentences: The family traces its lineage to a fourteenth-century merchant.
Parish records name every generation between him and the present owner.
clues: between him and the present owner
items.reason: 教区の記録が、その商人から現在の当主までの各世代を記していると述べられています

sentences: Landmines continue to maim farmers decades after the fighting ended.
Nine people lost a leg in the district last year alone.
clues: Nine people lost a leg in the district
items.reason: 昨年だけでその地区の九人が脚を失ったと述べられています

sentences: The council had to pare its cultural budget by a third.
Two festivals were cancelled, and one library lost its Saturday opening.
clues: one library lost its Saturday opening
items.reason: 祭り二つが取りやめになり、図書館一つは土曜の開館を失ったと述べられています

sentences: Purists scorn any recording made outside a concert hall.
They call such discs worthless and refuse to review them at all.
clues: refuse to review them at all
items.reason: そうした盤を無価値と呼び、批評も一切拒むと述べられています

sentences: The puppy would wriggle out of any collar they tried.
It twisted its shoulders and head until the strap slipped over its ears.
clues: It twisted its shoulders and head
until the strap slipped over its ears
items.reason: 肩と頭をひねり、帯が耳を越えて外れるまで動いたと述べられています

sentences: A skilled storyteller can mesmerize an audience of any age.
Children and adults alike sit without moving for the whole forty minutes.
clues: Children and adults alike sit without moving
items.reason: 子どもも大人も四十分のあいだ動かずに座っていると述べられています

sentences: Visitors climb the tower to behold the whole valley at once.
From the top they can see nine villages and both rivers on a clear day.
clues: From the top they can see nine villages
both rivers on a clear day
items.reason: 晴れた日には頂から九つの村と二本の川が見えると述べられています

sentences: Someone tried to sabotage the ventilation system during the night shift.
Two filters had been cut, and a switch was found taped in the off position.
clues: a switch was found taped in the off position
items.reason: 濾過装置二つが切られ、開閉器が切の位置で留められていたと述べられています

sentences: Workers remit part of their wages to families in the south every month.
Around a third of each pay packet leaves the city by bank transfer.
clues: Around a third of each pay packet
leaves the city by bank transfer
items.reason: 給与の三分の一ほどが、振込で市外へ出ていくと述べられています

sentences: The orchard yielded twice as much fruit as the previous season.
Nine tons were picked in September, against four the year before.
clues: Nine tons were picked in September
items.reason: 前年の四トンに対し、九月に九トンが収穫されたと述べられています

sentences: It transpired that the letter had been sent to the wrong department.
Nobody knew until a clerk found it in a tray three weeks later.
clues: Nobody knew until a clerk found it in a tray
items.reason: 三週間後に事務員が受け皿の中で見つけるまで、誰も知らなかったと述べられています

sentences: The chair adjourned the meeting until the following Tuesday.
Papers were left on the table, and the same agenda was taken up six days later.
clues: Papers were left on the table
the same agenda was taken up six days later
items.reason: 書類は卓に残され、六日後に同じ議題が取り上げられたと述べられています

sentences: Someone defaced every poster along the station platform.
Black paint covered the faces, and two sheets were torn across the middle.
clues: two sheets were torn across the middle
items.reason: 顔が黒い塗料で覆われ、二枚は中央から裂かれていたと述べられています

items.sense: (見知らぬ人に)近づいて話しかけた
sentences: A journalist accosted the minister as he left the building.
She stepped in front of him on the pavement and began asking about the contract.
clues: She stepped in front of him on the pavement
items.reason: 歩道で行く手に立ち、契約について問い始めたと述べられています

sentences: She parried the question with a joke about the weather.
She never mentioned the figure, and the room laughed instead of pressing her.
clues: the room laughed instead of pressing her
items.reason: 数字には触れず、場は追及せずに笑ったと述べられています

sentences: Nobody has ever fathomed why the letters were never posted.
They were written, sealed, and stamped, and then kept in a drawer for forty years.
clues: They were written, sealed, and stamped
kept in a drawer for forty years
items.reason: 書かれ封をされ切手も貼られた手紙が、四十年引き出しにあったと述べられています

sentences: The team forfeited the match by arriving two hours late.
The result was recorded as a defeat although no ball was kicked.
clues: The result was recorded as a defeat
items.reason: 一球も蹴られないまま、結果は敗戦として記録されたと述べられています

sentences: He wagered a week's wages on a horse he had never seen.
He put the money down at the window and tore up the slip an hour later.
clues: He put the money down at the window
tore up the slip an hour later
items.reason: 窓口で金を置き、一時間後にはその券を破いたと述べられています

sentences: Dry leaves rustled underfoot along the whole length of the path.
Every step made a light dry sound, and birds moved away ahead of us.
clues: Every step made a light dry sound
birds moved away ahead of us
items.reason: 一歩ごとに軽い乾いた音がし、前方の鳥が離れていったと述べられています

sentences: The old horse ambled across the field toward the gate.
It took ten minutes to cover two hundred meters and stopped twice to graze.
clues: It took ten minutes to cover two hundred meters
items.reason: 二百メートルに十分かけ、草を食べるため二度止まったと述べられています

sentences: The organizers allotted each speaker exactly twelve minutes for the presentation.
A bell rang at eleven minutes, and the microphone was switched off at twelve.
clues: A bell rang at eleven minutes
the microphone was switched off at twelve
items.reason: 十一分で鈴が鳴り、十二分で拡声器が切られたと述べられています

sentences: Do not dangle your feet over the side of the boat.
Keep them inside, because the propeller runs close to the surface here.
clues: the propeller runs close to the surface here
items.reason: この辺りは羽根が水面近くを回るため、足は中に入れておくよう言われています

sentences: The report does not allude to the earlier investigation at all.
Its two hundred pages never mention 2016, even in a footnote.
clues: Its two hundred pages never mention 2016
items.reason: 二百ページのどこにも、脚注にさえ二〇一六年が出てこないと述べられています

sentences: A single photograph can galvanize public opinion overnight.
One image of the beach brought forty thousand signatures in two days.
clues: brought forty thousand signatures in two days
items.reason: 浜辺の一枚の写真が、二日で四万の署名を集めたと述べられています

sentences: The captain gave the order to scuttle the ship at dawn.
Valves were opened below the waterline so that the enemy could not take her.
clues: Valves were opened below the waterline
so that the enemy could not take her
items.reason: 敵に奪われないよう、喫水線の下の弁が開かれたと述べられています

sentences: Cheap rents lured young designers into the disused mill.
Forty studios opened in two years because the space cost a fifth of the city rate.
clues: Forty studios opened in two years
the space cost a fifth of the city rate
items.reason: 市中の五分の一の賃料だったため、二年で四十の工房が開いたと述べられています

sentences: The survey elicited responses from more than nine thousand households.
A simple two-page form was returned by four out of five families.
clues: A simple two-page form was returned
by four out of five families
items.reason: 二ページの簡単な用紙が、五世帯のうち四世帯から返されたと述べられています

sentences: Reviewers lambasted the production for its careless translation.
Three papers listed the errors line by line and called the text unusable.
clues: Three papers listed the errors line by line
items.reason: 三紙が誤りを一行ずつ並べ、その台本は使えないと評したと述べられています

sentences: Invading armies plundered the abbey and burned its library.
They carried off the silver and the bells and left nothing in the cellars.
clues: They carried off the silver and the bells
items.reason: 銀器と鐘を持ち去り、地下にも何も残さなかったと述べられています

sentences: Bank staff are trained to recognize counterfeit notes by touch.
Real paper has raised ink, and the copies feel completely smooth.
items.reason: 本物の紙は印刷が盛り上がっているのに、写しは全く滑らかだと述べられています

sentences: Damp is an insidious problem that appears only years later.
Nothing shows on the surface while the timber behind the plaster slowly rots.
clues: the timber behind the plaster slowly rots
items.reason: 表面には何も出ないまま、漆喰の裏の木材がゆっくり腐ると述べられています

sentences: The publisher withdrew a chapter said to be defamatory.
It stated as fact that a named surgeon had been drunk during an operation.
clues: It stated as fact that a named surgeon had been drunk
items.reason: 名前を挙げた医師が手術中に酔っていたと、事実として書いていたと述べられています

sentences: His meticulous notes made the later reconstruction of the machine possible.
He recorded the position of every screw and the order of each step.
clues: He recorded the position of every screw
items.reason: 螺子一本ごとの位置と、各手順の順序まで記録していたと述べられています

sentences: He was oddly nonchalant about losing the entire deposit.
He shrugged, ordered coffee, and talked about football for the rest of the hour.
clues: talked about football for the rest of the hour
items.reason: 肩をすくめて珈琲を頼み、残りの一時間は蹴球の話をしていたと述べられています

sentences: The alibi seemed implausible from the very first hearing.
He claimed to have walked forty kilometers in three hours in the rain.
clues: He claimed to have walked forty kilometers in three hours
items.reason: 雨の中を三時間で四十キロ歩いたと述べたと書かれています

sentences: He is dogmatic about methods he has never actually tested.
He says there is only one correct way and refuses to read any study about the others.
clues: He says there is only one correct way
refuses to read any study about the others
items.reason: 正しい方法は一つだけだと言い、他の研究を読むことも拒むと述べられています

sentences: She is a voracious reader who finishes a novel every two days.
Her library card shows nine hundred loans in three years.
clues: Her library card shows nine hundred loans
items.reason: 三年で九百件の貸出が図書館の記録に残っていると述べられています

sentences: A lugubrious tune from the next room made everyone quiet.
It was played slowly on a low string, and two people asked for it to stop.
clues: It was played slowly on a low string
two people asked for it to stop
items.reason: 低い弦でゆっくり弾かれ、二人がやめてほしいと言ったと述べられています

sentences: The dialogue is banal, though the photography is remarkable.
Characters say only what the audience has heard in a hundred other films.
clues: Characters say only what the audience has heard
items.reason: 登場人物が他の百本の映画で聞いたことしか言わないと述べられています

sentences: The ladder rested in a precarious position against the wet wall.
Its feet stood on moss, and it shifted whenever anyone climbed two steps.
clues: it shifted whenever anyone climbed two steps
items.reason: 脚が苔の上にあり、二段上るたびにずれたと述べられています

sentences: Most of the mammals on the island are strictly nocturnal.
They leave their burrows after sunset and return before the sky lightens.
clues: They leave their burrows after sunset
items.reason: 日没後に巣穴を出て、空が明るむ前に戻ると述べられています

sentences: A languid breeze barely moved the flags above the entrance.
The cloth lifted once in a minute and hung still the rest of the time.
clues: The cloth lifted once in a minute
hung still the rest of the time
items.reason: 布は一分に一度持ち上がるだけで、あとは垂れたままだったと述べられています

sentences: A chivalrous gesture from the older player won over the crowd.
He helped his opponent up and gave him the ball for the free kick.
clues: gave him the ball for the free kick
items.reason: 相手を起こし、直接蹴球のために球を渡したと述べられています

sentences: The case against her was insubstantial and quickly collapsed.
It rested on one witness who withdrew, and no document was ever produced.
clues: It rested on one witness who withdrew
items.reason: 取り下げた証人一人に頼り、文書も一つも出されなかったと述べられています

sentences: The inn serves homely food at a very fair price.
Bread is baked in the kitchen, and the same three stews appear every week.
clues: Bread is baked in the kitchen
the same three stews appear every week
items.reason: パンは台所で焼かれ、同じ煮込み三種が毎週出ると述べられています

sentences: The mood in the office was subdued after the announcement.
Nobody played music, and conversations stopped when anyone walked past.
clues: conversations stopped when anyone walked past
items.reason: 音楽をかける人もなく、誰かが通ると会話が止まったと述べられています

sentences: The paper printed a lurid account of a very ordinary quarrel.
It used the word bloodbath twice about an argument over a parking space.
clues: It used the word bloodbath twice
about an argument over a parking space
items.reason: 駐車場所をめぐる口論について、血の海という語を二度使ったと述べられています

sentences: The advice sounds trite but works remarkably well in practice.
Everyone has heard it since childhood, and yet nine of ten patients improve.
clues: Everyone has heard it since childhood
items.reason: 誰もが子どもの頃から聞いている言葉なのに、十人のうち九人が改善すると述べられています

sentences: An adroit chairman kept the meeting to its allotted hour.
He cut two long speeches short without offending anyone and still took every vote.
clues: He cut two long speeches short without offending anyone
items.reason: 長い発言二つを気分を害さずに切り上げ、採決もすべて行ったと述べられています

sentences: The practice was outlawed as barbaric in the previous century.
It involved public whipping, and crowds were invited to watch.
items.reason: 公開での鞭打ちを伴い、群衆が見物に招かれたと述べられています

sentences: Constant interruption is detrimental to any careful work.
Error rates double when a task is broken off more than four times an hour.
clues: when a task is broken off more than four times an hour
items.reason: 一時間に四度以上中断されると、誤りの率が倍になると述べられています

sentences: A desultory conversation continued until the train arrived.
They spoke about the rain, then a film, then nothing at all for ten minutes.
clues: They spoke about the rain, then a film
then nothing at all for ten minutes
items.reason: 雨のこと、映画のことと移り、十分間は何も話さなかったと述べられています

sentences: A derisive laugh from the back row unsettled the speaker.
Someone repeated his last words in a high voice, and others joined in.
clues: Someone repeated his last words in a high voice
items.reason: 誰かが彼の最後の言葉を高い声で真似し、他の者も加わったと述べられています

sentences: The second design is marginally cheaper but much heavier.
It saves two thousand yen and adds nine kilograms.
items.reason: 二千円安くなる一方、九キロ重くなると述べられています

sentences: He bashfully accepted the prize and left the stage quickly.
He looked at his shoes, said four words, and would not face the cameras.
clues: He looked at his shoes, said four words
items.reason: 靴を見て四語だけ述べ、撮影機の方も向かなかったと述べられています

sentences: The children watched intently as the potter shaped the bowl.
Not one of them spoke, and their eyes followed his hands for ten minutes.
clues: their eyes followed his hands for ten minutes
items.reason: 誰も口をきかず、十分のあいだ手の動きを目で追ったと述べられています

sentences: She tenaciously pursued the records through four separate archives.
She wrote thirty letters and travelled to two cities at her own expense.
clues: travelled to two cities at her own expense
items.reason: 三十通の手紙を書き、自費で二つの都市へ足を運んだと述べられています

sentences: Their grandmother doted on the youngest child quite openly.
She saved the best seat for him and sent presents twice a month.
clues: She saved the best seat for him
items.reason: 一番良い席を取っておき、月に二度贈り物を送ったと述べられています

sentences: The witness claimed he had been stitched up by his own partner.

clues: He said the documents in his desk
had been placed there by someone else
items.reason: 机の中の書類は他の誰かが置いたものだと述べたと書かれています

sentences: Officials whisked away the visiting minister before anyone could ask questions.
Two cars waited at the side door, and he was gone within thirty seconds.
clues: Two cars waited at the side door
he was gone within thirty seconds
items.reason: 脇の扉に車二台が待ち、三十秒で姿が消えたと述べられています

sentences: He was passed over for the post he had been promised.
Someone from another office was appointed, and he stayed at the same desk.
clues: Someone from another office was appointed
he stayed at the same desk
items.reason: 別の部署の人が任じられ、彼は同じ席に留まったと述べられています

sentences: The stall raked in more money on Saturday than all week.
It took three hundred thousand yen in six hours, against ninety in five days.
clues: It took three hundred thousand yen in six hours
items.reason: 五日で九万円だったところ、六時間で三十万円を売り上げたと述べられています

sentences: My grandfather swore by cold water for every minor ailment.

clues: He recommended it for headaches, cuts, and sleeplessness
